title: Machine Unlearning for Federated Socially Fair k-Means Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2610.13717v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated clustering can support applications such as patient stratification across hospitals and customer segmentation across distributed financial datasets. Responsible AI calls for fair representation of demographic groups and support for data deletion, motivated in part by rights such as the GDPR's right to erasure. These goals interact: deleting records can change the balance between groups and alter the clustering of the remaining population. We study exact machine unlearning for federated socially fair $k$-means, whose objective is to minimize the largest group-average squared distance to the nearest center. Our approach keeps separate local summaries for each group, so summaries at unaffected institutions remain valid as global fairness weights change. translated_title: 面向联邦社会公平k-均值聚类的机器遗忘
translated_abstract: 联邦聚类可以支持跨医院的患者分层以及跨分布式金融数据集的客户细分等应用。负责任的人工智能要求对各人口群体进行公平表示，并支持数据删除，这在一定程度上源于《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）中的删除权等权利。这些目标之间相互作用：删除记录可能会改变群体之间的平衡，并改变剩余数据总体的聚类结果。我们研究了联邦社会公平k-均值聚类的精确机器遗忘问题，其目标是最小化到最近中心的最大群体平均平方距离。我们的方法为每个群体保留单独的本地摘要，因此当全局公平权重发生变化时，未受影响的机构的摘要仍然有效。对于两个群体的情况，我们证明了在理想采样下与客户端群体比例无关的初始化近似保证，并且我们表明同种子重放可以复现重训练的结果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种联邦社会公平k-均值聚类的精确机器遗忘方法，通过为每个群体维护独立的本地摘要，使得在全局公平权重变化时未受影响机构的摘要依然有效，并在理想采样下证明了与客户端群体比例无关的初始化近似保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes exact machine unlearning for federated socially fair k-means clustering by maintaining separate per-group local summaries that remain valid as global fairness weights change, proving an initialization approximation guarantee independent of client group proportions under ideal sampling.
